# Wandershops

> Wandershops connects local vendors and neighborhood shoppers. Customers discover local stores, browse product catalogues with prices, check store hours, and order directly on WhatsApp.

## Platform Summary
- **Website**: https://wandershops.com
- **App Scheme**: wandershops://
- **Core Entities**: Local Stores (`/web/shop/{slug}`) and Products (`/web/product/{id}`)
- **Primary Interaction**: Instant direct order and inquiry via WhatsApp

## Discovery Taxonomy
Wandershops indexes neighborhood stores by **Store Category** and **Geographic Place/City**:
- **Store Categories**: Apparel & Accessories, Home & Hardware, Food & Beverages, Lifestyle & Decor, Electronics & Tech, Automobiles, Wedding & Event rentals, Other.
- **Location Entity**: Each store is associated with a verified `Place` (locality/town/city), street address, PostGIS coordinates, and Google Maps pin.

## URL Structure for LLM & Search Agents
- `/web/shop/{slug}`: Full store profile with structured JSON-LD (LocalBusiness subtypes like `ClothingStore`, `GroceryStore`, etc.), opening hours, geo coordinates, product catalogue, and verified ratings.
- `/web/product/{id}`: Detailed product page with JSON-LD `Product` schema, sanitized numeric price, availability, seller details, and direct WhatsApp order link.
- `/sitemap.xml`: Complete machine-readable index of all live public stores, products, and legal/support pages.
- `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association` & `/.well-known/assetlinks.json`: Mobile deep-link configurations for iOS and Android.
